text: Surface the latest blocked authority decision in the watchdog panel
description: Extend the frontend watchdog state contract to retain the bounded authority audit received from socket/runtime hydration. Derive the latest non-execute decision and render a compact operator-facing notice in WatchdogPanel showing action type and whether it was refused, stopped, or needs human authorization, with machine-readable reasons available in accessible detail. Do not render model payloads or entire audit history. Add store/panel tests for live and hydrated state, escalation wording, and absence when all decisions execute. Verify with focused tests and a production build without starting or restarting servers.

reflections.context: Authority decisions were enforced, audited, restored, and persisted, but frontend SupervisorStateInfo and WatchdogPanel exposed only state/color and a free-text stop reason. The human could not inspect the structured blocked action.
reflections.outcome: Extended frontend watchdog state with bounded authority entries and a computed latestBlockedAuthorityDecision sourced identically from live socket and hydrated runtime state. Added a compact accessible panel notice for escalate/refuse/stop showing canonical action type and machine-readable reasons, while hiding execute-only histories and never rendering payloads or the full audit.
reflections.effectiveness: Focused WatchdogPanel/store tests pass 15/15; frontend production build and vue-tsc type-check pass; git diff --check passes. Tests cover hydrated escalation derivation, operator wording, policy reason detail, exclusion of older execute history, and absence for all-execute audits. No server was started or restarted.
reflections.lesson: Human-in-the-loop safety is incomplete until the enforcement decision is legible at the operator surface. Show the minimum actionable structured fact, not raw prompts or an overwhelming event log.
reflections.pattern: Carry canonical safety metadata end-to-end, derive one current operator concern in the store, and render it with accessible status semantics and progressive disclosure.

status.comment: Latest blocked authority decision is visible in the watchdog panel and internally verified; awaiting explicit user visual acceptance before done.

valueRationale: A correct escalation is only cooperative if the responsible human can see what was blocked and why.
